articles.title: Watch India launch advanced military satellite on rocket's 1st flight since May 2025 failure
articles.summary: An Indian PSLV rocket is scheduled for launch tonight (Jan 11), marking its return to flight. It will carry the EOS-N1 military satellite, along with 15 other payloads into orbit. This mission highlights India's growing space capabilities and its commitment to strengthening defence infrastructure through advanced satellite technology, crucial for national security.

articles.title: Finland's withdrawal from Ottawa Convention to take effect
articles.summary: Finland's Ministry of Defence confirmed its withdrawal from the Ottawa Anti-Personnel Landmines Convention, effective January 10, 2026. This strategic decision reflects Finland's re-evaluation of its defence posture and sovereign military requirements. For SSB aspirants, this highlights nations' challenges in balancing international disarmament treaties with evolving national security imperatives and operational needs.

articles.title: Aatmanirbharta in defence is a national imperative & necessity for long-term strategic autonomy, says Defence Secretary at Defence Skilling Conclave
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence highlights unprecedented opportunities for the nation's defence sector. These arise from evolving global supply chains and rapid technological advancements. This official perspective emphasizes leveraging these shifts to foster growth, innovation, and self-reliance within India's defence industry. The statement signals a proactive strategy to capitalize on current global dynamics, aiming to strengthen defence capabilities and global standing.

articles.title: SUA. Proteste de amploare, cu zeci de mii de oameni, la Minneapolis, dar și în numeroase alte orașe, în urma uciderii unei femei de către un agent al Serviciului pentru Imigrație. Manifestațiile au fost pașnice, cu excepția distrugerii unor hoteluri în care, aparent, sunt găzduiți agenții ICE. În jur de 30 de persoane au fost arestate.
articles.summary: A large rally and protest recently took place in Minneapolis, Minnesota, specifically targeting Trump's Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) policies. Participants gathered in huge crowds, vocally demanding justice for Renee Good, whose name was chanted repeatedly, highlighting concerns over ICE actions and human rights.

articles.title: Countdown for launch of PSLV-C62 rocket commences
articles.summary: ISRO initiated a 22.5-hour countdown from Sriharikota for its PSLV rocket launch. This mission aims to place an earth observation satellite into orbit, accompanied by 14 co-passenger satellites. This significant space endeavor showcases India's advanced capabilities in satellite deployment and Earth monitoring, reinforcing ISRO's consistent contributions to global space science and technology.

articles.title: PM Modi, German Chancellor Merz set for crucial talks in Ahmedabad amid rising geopolitical tension
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor are set for wide-ranging talks in New Delhi, focusing on strengthening bilateral ties. Key areas of discussion will include trade, investment, critical technologies, and defence cooperation. This high-level engagement aims to deepen the strategic partnership and collaboration between India and Germany across crucial sectors, enhancing mutual interests and global standing.
